SELECT (t1.due_amount_c - t1.deduct_amount_c) deductible_amount, (t1.principal_c - t1.deduct_principal_c) deductible_principal, (t1.interest_c - t1.deduct_interest_c) deductible_interest, t1.deduct_amount, t1.deduct_principal, t1.deduct_id, t1.deduct_interest, t1.cashflow_id, t1.cf_item, t1.cf_item_desc, t1.payment_req_id FROM (SELECT (SELECT cc.due_amount FROM con_contract_cashflow cc WHERE cc.cashflow_id = d.cashflow_id) due_amount_c,
(SELECT SUM(cpd.deduct_amount) FROM csh_payment_deduct cpd WHERE cpd.cashflow_id = d.cashflow_id) deduct_amount_c,
(SELECT cc.principal FROM con_contract_cashflow cc WHERE cc.cashflow_id = d.cashflow_id) principal_c,
(SELECT SUM(cpd.deduct_principal) FROM csh_payment_deduct cpd WHERE cpd.cashflow_id = d.cashflow_id) deduct_principal_c,
(SELECT cc.interest FROM con_contract_cashflow cc WHERE cc.cashflow_id = d.cashflow_id) interest_c,
(SELECT SUM(cpd.deduct_interest) FROM csh_payment_deduct cpd WHERE cpd.cashflow_id = d.cashflow_id) deduct_interest_c, d.deduct_amount, d.deduct_principal, d.deduct_interest, d.deduct_id, ccc.cashflow_id, ccc.cf_item, (select hci.description from hls_cashflow_item hci,hls_cashflow_type hct where hct.cf_type = hci.cf_type and hci.cf_item = ccc.cf_item and hci.cf_type = ccc.cf_type) as cf_item_desc, d.payment_req_id FROM csh_payment_deduct d,con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.cashflow_id = d.cashflow_id) t1
t1.cf_item in (2,51)
AND t1.payment_req_id = #{paymentReqId}
